title: Hinomori Shizuku — A Night Date At PXL〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wasn't the night show just absolutely incredible, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it totally was! I don't think I'll ever forget what I saw today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I feel the same way. It was also wonderful how they included all the rides and guests to be a part of the show♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It really was! I love the way they made use of those bracelets too.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah. We do cheers and stuff together with the audience during shows, but I never would've come up with this kind of idea.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. We might not be able to copy them, but it might be fun to try out something like that♪>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh, I'd like that too♪ Let's try coming up with some ideas when we get back!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Thank you very much for inviting us out today, Shizuku, Airi.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, it was our pleasure. We had fun too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's not every day that you get to go to an amusement park as such a big party!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Alright, we should probably head back!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <See you in SEKAI!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Stay safe, you two.
And thanks for today.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, thank you so much for inviting us!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Bye bye♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm so glad everyone had fun today.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It would've been nice to hang out a little more, but I can't stay out too late...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I should probably head home soon too, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't you want to stay just a little bit longer? The lines for some rides are pretty much gone now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A-Are you sure...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I mean, it's written all over your face.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...
Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, anything you want to go on?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How about the roller coaster we went on during the day? It'd be nice to go on it again since it's all lit up now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, roller coaster it is!
Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, seeing the entire park lit up the way it is when we reached the top was something else too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And it's after we got to see the night show, so it feels just that much more meaningful!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. It was such a lovely story.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi, look!
It's Poochie!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
Poochie's one of this park's mascots.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: He is?! Oh, why don't we go take a picture with him?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go ask!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Poochie, can we take a picture with you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for doing this, Poochie!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It's really hard not to like him, you know? I mean, the way his eyes droop is so cute.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What is it?
Are you that happy about getting to take a picture with Poochie?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Of course♪
It really is a wonderful photo of us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Along with so many other memories. I couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The album of all the things we've done just keeps growing too. Look...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, this is from that picnic.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, the day I became friends with Mizuki and Ena.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. It would've been a great experience too if only we hadn't fallen down that ledge...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, there's also the Summer Festival!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm not sure I'll ever forget that ring-tossing competition we had with Ena.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember that, and how I hooked a ring onto my neighbor's target.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And this is gonna be another day to remember.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We got to relax, enjoy ourselves and see something that should help us come up with ideas for our own shows!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree completely.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What do you think Haruka and her friends are doing right now?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Probably having as much fun as they can, right? I mean, they all seemed pretty close.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Maybe more fun than us. They could be running around somewhere in Phenny hats right now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Phenny hats! That's a wonderful idea♪ I think I'll buy a pair for Shii and myself as a little souvenir to remember today by.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm pretty sure I just saw a gift shop nearby, so let's go pick some up!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay...!
